pickuphighlight.config.title: PickupHighlight Config
pickuphighlight.config.clearOnHover.tool: Removes the highlight when you hover over the item.
pickuphighlight.config.clearOnClose.tool: Removes all highlights when you close your inventory.
pickuphighlight.config.clearOnSelect.too: Removes the highlight when you select the item on your hotbar.
pickuphighlight.config.highlightColor.to: RGB color of the sparkle icon (hex integer, default: 0xFFD700 gold).
pickuphighlight.config.timeoutSeconds.to: Automatically clear highlights after this many seconds. 0 = never.
